live_matches.description: The series will be decided at Nottingham as both England and New Zealand will look to dominate from Day 1. Can the hosts comeback strong after a formidable defeat at the Oval or will the Kiwis carry their momentum through to the 3rd Test? Catch all the action from New Zealand Tour of England 2026, LIVE on Sony LIV.
